description: Agent Events: submit an event’s registration list with its capacity and eligibility terms: the list with the event, the registered count it states and each registration with its id, name, the audience it is recorded under, when it was made, its status (registered, waitlisted or cancelled) and each condition it is recorded as meeting; the terms with the event, the capacity, the registration deadline, each audience admitted and each condition a registration must meet. The signed report gives the list and the terms, the active registrations counted against the capacity, each registration’s audience against the audiences admitted, its conditions against those required and its registration time against the deadline, with every excluded registration named, and counts them, and names a divergent list: more active registrations than the capacity, a registration under an audience the terms do not admit, one lacking a required condition and one made after the stated deadline; then a stated count unlike the list and another event name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No capacity in the terms, or registrations with no audience, conditions or registration time where the terms state them, leaves the list unverified. Waitlisted and cancelled registrations do not count; audiences and conditions read by their words with plurals folded; registration times compare to the minute where both carry a time of day, otherwise by the day. This reads an event’s registration list against its own terms: wever_commitment-deadline-check judges whether an agent’s open commitments fit its capacity by their deadlines, and this family judges no feasibility and evaluates no deadlines, so a registration past a stated deadline is a record mismatch, not a feasibility finding; wever_auto-registration-check reads a vehicle registration document against the vehicle record, its plate, VIN, owners and expiry, and the word is the only overlap; and wever_agent-registry-check reads an agent registry against deployment and usage lists, registers no one for anything and reads no attendee list, while the registration check reads the people registered for one event against its capacity and terms. Verdict event_registration_divergent, event_registration_partial, event_registration_unverified or event_registration_consistent. POST /api/event-registration-check. Reads the event records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never books a venue, registers or invites anyone, sells or refunds a ticket, publishes an announcement, or judges whether an event should happen, was well run, or was worth attending, only whether its records agree with each other and with what was announced, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Events reads an organized event’s records for consistency between documents: an event brief, a published agenda, speaker confirmations, a registration list, a venue arrangement, a ticketing record, a public announcement and a post-event report, each against the requirements, plan, lineup, capacity and eligibility terms, brief, announced terms, schedule or records it should agree with. Beside it, the Standing jobs rail tools such as wever_schedule-create register, list, report on and cancel recurring jobs and keep state, and wever_meeting-brief states one meeting’s decisions and action items from its notes, while this family keeps no state, registers nothing, runs nothing and reads the records in the call against each other and against what was announced. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-events-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-events/.
